description: This file defines a static class 'PdfFileFormatter' that provides a method to read, process, and save a PDF document by uncompressing all stream objects and saving it as a new file.

classes.name: PdfFileFormatter
classes.description: A static utility class for reading, formatting, and saving PDF files by uncompressing streams.

methods.name: FormatDocument
methods.description: Reads a PDF document from a specified path, uncompresses all stream objects, and saves a newly formatted copy.
